findings.summary: Pre-existing engine bug confirmed by Opus: XbridgesEngine.compile ignores edges OUT of stateful blocks and counts edges INTO them, so consumers of an Integrator run before it and read the previous stage's output. RK4 on x'=-x, h=0.1: one step gives 0.9025 instead of the RK4 value 0.9048375 (2.6 % error after 10 steps: first-order behaviour). Affects every X-Bridges simulation and solver.
Measured before fix: every fixed-step solver converges with order 1 on x'=-x (error ratio ~2 for ode2/3/4/5); ode45 misses 1e-6 by 75x; ordering depends on block insertion order.

wps.review: Opus 2026-10-20: convergence ratios after fix ode2 4.08, ode3 8.33, ode4 16.68, ode5 39.1; no legacy test changed or broken by the new order. src/help/helpCoverage.test.ts 'requires fresh live UI evidence...' fails identically on baseline 49f07cf (pre-existing, unrelated: stale live-UI report).
